title: test_auth_session_endpoint_response_time_and_data_integrity
description: Verify that the /api/auth/session endpoint returns session data within 500ms and includes valid user and session objects.

title: test_auth_getcurrentuser_endpoint_role_based_access
description: Ensure /api/auth/getCurrentUser returns the authenticated user's profile with correct role and location, enforcing role-based access control.

title: test_shipments_eta_endpoint_valid_uuid_and_eta_accuracy
description: Test /api/shipments/{id}/eta endpoint with valid shipment UUID to confirm accurate ETA calculation and shipment tracking details.

title: test_invoices_create_endpoint_gst_compliance_and_invoice_creation
description: Validate /api/invoices/create endpoint creates GST-compliant invoices correctly with required fields and returns success response.

title: test_invoices_generate_pdf_endpoint_branding_and_data_accuracy
description: Check /api/invoices/generate endpoint generates branded PDF invoices with accurate invoice data and returns success status.

title: test_barcodes_generate_endpoint_standard_barcode_creation
description: Verify /api/barcodes/generate endpoint creates standard barcodes with valid barcodeNumber and optional shipmentId, returning success.

title: test_scans_post_endpoint_record_scan_event
description: Ensure /api/scans POST endpoint records package scan events accurately with barcode, scanType, location, and operatorId.

title: test_inventory_post_endpoint_stock_adjustment_and_alerts
description: Test /api/inventory POST endpoint adjusts stock levels correctly for various adjustment types and triggers low stock alerts if applicable.

title: test_manifests_post_endpoint_create_update_manifest
description: Validate /api/manifests POST endpoint creates or updates air cargo manifests with required origin and destination fields.

title: test_customers_update_endpoint_modify_customer_details
description: Verify /api/customers/update POST endpoint updates customer details including contact and GST information successfully.
